ev.q: the weighted SGTP estimate from ICATT was 20% (95% CI = 18%–23%)
SGTP accounted for >50% of specimens in HHS regions 1–3 and >20% in all other regions
SGTF/SGTP results were available sooner (median = 2 days; IQR = 1) than were genomic sequencing results
Limitations are that SGTF/SGTP monitoring is assay-dependent
Trends in SGTP proportions aligned with genomic sequencing results

methods_quotes.q: Trends were assessed in SGTP proportions, variant proportions, and nowcast estimates; all were weighted to represent RT-PCR–positive specimens by state
Geographic representativeness and median interval from specimen collection to result were calculated for both data sources.
SGTF/SGTP classification was made based on a 50% threshold.
